ABSTRACT 
 
HirePathAI is an AI-powered job portal designed to make the job search and recruitment 
process easier, faster, and more efficient for students, freshers, and job seekers. In today's 
competitive world, finding a suitable job according to educational qualifications, skills, 
experience, and career interests is a major challenge. Many candidates are unable to identify the 
skills required for their desired jobs or prepare a professional resume. HirePathAI aims to solve 
these problems by providing a smart and user-friendly platform that connects job seekers with 
suitable career opportunities. 
The main objective of this project is to help candidates find relevant jobs, analyze their resumes, 
identify missing skills, and improve their professional profiles. The system provides various 
features to support users throughout their job search journey. 
 
Key Features of HirePathAI: 
1. User Registration and Login: Allows users to create an account, log in, and manage 
their personal profiles. 
2. Job Search and Apply: Helps users explore available job opportunities and apply for 
jobs according to their interests and qualifications. 
3. Resume Analysis: Analyzes uploaded resumes and checks the skills and information 
mentioned in them. 
4. Missing Skill Detection: Identifies the skills that are missing from a candidate's profile 
according to the selected job requirements. 
5. YouTube Learning Links: Provides useful YouTube learning resources to help 
candidates learn missing skills and improve their knowledge. 
6. Resume Builder: Helps users create or improve their resumes in a professional format. 
 
HirePathAI aims to reduce the time and effort required for job searching by providing multiple 
career-related services on a single platform. It helps candidates understand their skill gaps, 
improve their resumes, develop new skills, and find suitable employment opportunities. 
Overall, HirePathAI provides a smart and organized approach to job searching and career 
development by using Artificial Intelligence to improve the job-seeking experience and help 
candidates move towards better career opportunities.

CHAPTER 1: INTRODUCTION 
 
 
1.1 Topic of the System 
Project Title: HirePathAI – AI-Powered Job Portal 
HirePathAI is a web-based job portal developed to help students, freshers, and job seekers 
find suitable employment opportunities. The idea behind this project is to make the job 
searching process easier by bringing different career-related facilities together on one 
platform. 
Finding a suitable job is not always easy, especially for candidates who are starting their 
careers. Many students complete their education but are not fully aware of the technical 
skills required by companies. Some candidates also face problems while preparing their 
resumes or selecting jobs according to their abilities. 
HirePathAI provides a platform where users can explore job opportunities, select their 
desired job roles, upload resumes, and check whether their skills match the selected job 
requirements. It also helps candidates find the skills they need to improve and provides 
YouTube learning links for further learning. 
The system focuses on connecting a candidate's existing skills with the requirements of 
available jobs. Its main purpose is to help users make better career decisions and prepare 
themselves for employment opportunities. 
 
1.2 Project Overview 
HirePathAI is designed as an online platform that supports candidates during different 
stages of their job search. It provides facilities for account creation, job exploration, resume 
checking, skill improvement, and job applications. 
A user first registers or logs in to the portal. After entering the platform, the user can 
explore different companies and available job positions. Once a suitable job is selected, the

candidate can upload a resume for analysis. 
The resume analysis facility examines the skills present in the uploaded resume and 
compares them with the requirements of the selected job. If some required skills are not 
found, the system identifies them as missing skills. This gives candidates a clearer idea of 
what they should learn before applying for a particular position. 
The portal also provides YouTube learning links related to missing skills. Users can follow 
these resources to improve their technical knowledge. In addition, the resume builder 
facility helps candidates prepare or improve their resumes. 
The main facilities provided by HirePathAI are: 
1. Registration and Login: Users can create accounts and access the job portal through 
their login details. 
2. Job Search: Candidates can explore available jobs and select positions according to 
their career interests. 
3. Job Application: Users can apply for suitable job opportunities through the platform. 
4. Resume Analysis: The system checks the uploaded resume and identifies the skills 
mentioned in it. 
5. Missing Skill Detection: It finds the skills that are required for a selected job but are 
not present in the candidate's resume. 
6. YouTube Learning Links: It provides learning resources that help users develop the 
skills they are missing. 
7. Job Matching: The system helps candidates understand the suitability of their profiles 
for selected jobs through matching scores and recommendations. 
8. Resume Builder: Users can create or improve their resumes to present their 
qualifications and skills in a better way. 
By combining these facilities, HirePathAI aims to make the job search process more 
organized and useful for candidates. 
 
1.3 Objectives 
The main objective of HirePathAI is to develop a job portal that helps candidates search for 
suitable jobs and understand the skills required to achieve their career goals. 
The specific objectives of the project are: 
1. To develop a simple and user-friendly online job portal for students, freshers, and job 
seekers. 
2. To provide registration and login facilities for accessing the system. 
3. To allow users to explore available companies and job opportunities. 
4. To provide an option for uploading resumes and checking their contents. 
5. To compare the skills available in a resume with the requirements of a selected job.

6. To identify missing skills so that candidates can understand their areas of improvement. 
7. To provide useful YouTube learning links for developing the required skills. 
8. To suggest relevant job opportunities according to the candidate's profile and skills. 
9. To display a job matching score that helps users understand how closely their skills 
match a selected position. 
10. To help candidates prepare better resumes through the resume builder facility. 
11. To reduce the time spent on searching for jobs and understanding job requirements. 
The overall aim is to provide candidates with useful information and facilities that can 
support them in preparing for employment. 
 
1.4 Target Users 
HirePathAI is mainly intended for people who are searching for employment or preparing 
themselves for future career opportunities. Different types of users can benefit from the 
facilities provided by the system. 
1. Students: 
Students who are pursuing graduation or other professional courses can use the portal to 
explore job opportunities. They can also understand which technical skills are useful for the 
career they want to choose. 
2. Freshers: 
Freshers who have recently completed their education can use HirePathAI to search for 
entry-level positions. The resume analysis and missing skill detection facilities can help 
them understand the requirements of different job roles. 
3. Job Seekers: 
People who are looking for new employment opportunities can explore available jobs and 
compare their existing skills with the requirements of selected positions. 
4. Candidates Improving Their Skills: 
Users who want to learn new technologies or improve their existing knowledge can use the 
YouTube learning links provided by the portal. These resources can help them work on the 
skills required for their desired jobs. 
5. Career Beginners: 
People who are unsure about which job role is suitable for their qualifications can explore 
different opportunities and understand the skills expected for those positions. 
Therefore, HirePathAI is useful for candidates at different stages of their education and 
professional journey. 
 
1.5 Problem Statement 
Searching for a suitable job is a difficult process for many students, freshers, and job

seekers. Although several online job portals are available, candidates may still struggle to 
understand which opportunities are suitable for their current skills and qualifications. 
One common problem is that candidates often apply for jobs without checking all the skills 
mentioned in the job description. They may have some of the required skills but lack others 
that are important for the selected position. Without proper guidance, it becomes difficult 
for them to identify these gaps. 
Resume preparation is another challenge. Many freshers do not have enough experience in 
creating a well-organized resume. They may also be unaware of how to improve their 
resumes according to different job requirements. 
Candidates also spend time searching for learning materials when they discover that they 
need additional technical skills. Finding useful resources for the right topic can become 
another part of the job preparation process. 
The major problems are: 
 
Difficulty in finding jobs according to personal skills and qualifications. 
 
Lack of understanding of job-specific skill requirements. 
 
Difficulty in identifying missing skills. 
 
Problems in preparing and improving resumes. 
 
Lack of proper learning guidance for required skills. 
 
Time spent searching for suitable job opportunities and learning resources. 
Proposed Solution: 
HirePathAI is developed to address these difficulties through a single online platform. It 
allows users to explore jobs, upload resumes, check their skills, and identify the 
requirements they still need to fulfil. The portal also provides YouTube learning links and 
resume-building facilities to support candidates in improving their job readiness. 
The system aims to make the job searching and preparation process more convenient by 
providing these facilities in one place. 
 
1.6 Scope of the Project 
The scope of HirePathAI covers job searching, resume checking, skill identification, and 
career preparation. The project is designed to provide useful facilities to candidates who 
want to find employment opportunities and improve their professional profiles. 
The major areas covered by this project are described below: 
1. User Account Management 
The portal provides registration and login facilities through which users can access the 
system and use its available features. 
2. Job Search and Application 
Users can explore available job positions, check job-related information, select suitable

opportunities, and apply for jobs according to their interests. 
3. Resume Upload and Analysis 
Candidates can upload their resumes so that the system can examine the information and 
skills included in them. 
4. Missing Skill Identification 
The system compares the candidate's skills with the requirements of the selected job. It 
highlights the skills that are not available in the resume but are required for that position. 
5. Learning Support 
The portal provides YouTube learning links related to the missing skills. Candidates can 
use these resources to improve their knowledge and learn new technologies. 
6. Job Recommendations and Matching 
The system helps users explore relevant job opportunities and understand the level of 
similarity between their skills and the requirements of a selected job. 
7. Resume Building 
The resume builder facility supports candidates in preparing a resume or improving their 
existing resume in a professional format. 
8. Future Development 
In the future, the portal can be extended with additional facilities such as interview 
preparation, advanced career guidance, more detailed job recommendations, and additional 
recruiter-related features. 
The project mainly focuses on making job searching and skill improvement easier through 
a common online platform. 
 
1.7 Technologies Used 
Different web development technologies are used to build HirePathAI. Each technology

HTML (HyperText Markup Language) provides the basic structure of web pages. It is used

5. CSS 
CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to control the appearance of the application. It helps

6. JavaScript 
JavaScript is used to implement interactive behaviour and application functionality. 
7. Visual Studio Code 
Visual Studio Code is a source-code editor used for writing, editing, and managing the

8. GitHub 
GitHub is used to store and manage the project's source code. It also helps developers

These technologies provide the development environment required to build and maintain 
the HirePathAI web application. 
 
1.8 Conclusion 
This chapter introduced HirePathAI, its main purpose, objectives, target users, and the 
problems it aims to address. The project is developed to support students, freshers, and job 
seekers who face difficulties while searching for suitable employment opportunities. 
The portal brings several useful facilities together, including job search, job application, 
resume analysis, missing skill detection, YouTube learning resources, job 
recommendations, matching scores, and resume building. 
One of the important aspects of the system is that it does not only help candidates explore 
jobs but also gives them an idea of the skills they need to improve for their selected job 
roles. This can help users prepare better before applying for employment opportunities. 
Overall, HirePathAI aims to provide a convenient platform for job searching and career 
preparation. The following chapters explain the background, analysis, design,

CHAPTER 2: LITERATURE REVIEW 
 
2.1 Introduction to Job Portals 
A job portal is an online platform that helps people search for employment opportunities 
and allows companies to share information about vacant positions. It provides a common 
place where job seekers can explore different career options without visiting companies 
individually. 
In earlier times, people mainly depended on newspapers, personal contacts, advertisements, 
and direct visits to companies to find jobs. With the growth of internet technology, the 
process of searching and applying for jobs has become more convenient. Candidates can 
now explore job openings, read job descriptions, and submit their resumes through online 
platforms. 
Job portals are useful for both candidates and employers. Candidates can search for jobs 
according to their qualifications, experience, and interests, while employers can publish 
vacancies and receive applications from interested people. 
The common facilities available on job portals include: 
1. User Registration: Allows candidates to create their accounts and provide personal 
information. 
2. Job Search: Helps users find available vacancies according to different job roles and 
requirements. 
3. Resume Upload: Allows candidates to upload their resumes for job applications. 
4. Job Application: Provides an option to apply for available positions online. 
5. Company Information: Displays details about companies and their available 
opportunities. 
6. Job Notifications: Helps users stay informed about new job openings. 
7. Profile Management: Allows candidates to update their educational details, skills, and 
other information. 
HirePathAI is developed with the same basic purpose of providing job-related services. 
However, it also focuses on resume analysis and missing skill identification to help 
candidates understand their preparation level for a selected job.

LinkedIn is a professional networking platform where users can create professional

2.3 Role of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment 
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a technology that enables computer systems to perform tasks 
that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding information, identifying 
patterns, and making predictions. 
In recruitment, AI can help process candidate information and support different activities 
involved in finding suitable employees. It can be used to examine resumes, identify 
relevant skills, compare candidate profiles with job descriptions, and suggest suitable job 
opportunities.

Some important uses of AI in recruitment are explained below: 
1. Resume Screening 
AI-based tools can examine information present in resumes and identify details such as 
education, experience, technical skills, and qualifications. This can help organize candidate 
information. 
2. Skill Identification 
AI-based techniques can help identify skills mentioned in a resume and compare them with 
the skills required for a particular job position. 
3. Job Recommendations 
Recommendation systems can suggest job opportunities by comparing candidate 
information with job requirements. 
4. Matching Score 
A matching system can calculate a score based on the skills or other criteria shared 
between a candidate's profile and a job description. 
5. Recruitment Support 
AI tools can help organize applications and reduce repetitive work during the initial stages 
of recruitment. 
6. Learning and Skill Improvement 
AI-supported platforms can identify areas where candidates need improvement and suggest 
relevant learning resources. 
Research on AI recruitment also highlights the importance of accuracy, transparency, and 
fairness. AI systems should be designed carefully because incorrect or biased data can 
affect their recommendations.

2.4 Resume Analysis and Job Matching Systems 
A resume contains important information about a candidate, such as educational 
qualifications, technical skills, projects, certifications, and work experience. Employers use 
this information to understand whether a candidate is suitable for a particular position. 
Resume analysis is the process of examining the information provided in a resume and 
identifying details that are relevant to a job requirement. 
Job matching is the process of comparing a candidate's qualifications and skills with the 
requirements of a job. It helps identify how closely a candidate's profile matches a 
particular position. 
The main steps involved in resume analysis and job matching are:

1. Resume Upload 
The candidate uploads a resume to the platform. The resume acts as the source of 
information for checking the candidate's skills and qualifications. 
2. Information Extraction 
The system examines the uploaded resume to identify relevant information, such as 
technical skills, education, and experience. 
3. Job Requirement Identification 
The required skills and qualifications are identified from the selected job description. 
4. Skill Comparison 
The candidate's available skills are compared with the skills required for the selected job. 
5. Missing Skill Identification 
Skills that are required for the job but are not found in the resume are identified as missing 
skills. 
6. Matching Score 
A matching score can be used to represent how closely the candidate's available skills 
match the selected job requirements. 
7. Learning Recommendations 
Learning resources can be provided to help candidates improve the skills they need for 
their desired position. 
In HirePathAI, these steps help users understand their current skill level in relation to a 
selected job. Instead of only searching for vacancies, candidates can also identify the areas 
where they need improvement. 
Studies of job recommendation systems discuss different approaches to representing job 
requirements and candidate skills. They also highlight the need for understandable and fair 
recommendations.

2.5 Identified Gaps and Opportunities 
After studying the general working of existing job portals and AI-based recruitment 
systems, some areas were identified where additional facilities can make job searching 
more helpful for candidates. 
Many job portals concentrate mainly on displaying job vacancies and allowing candidates 
to submit applications. However, candidates may still need additional guidance to 
understand whether their existing skills are suitable for their desired positions. 
The following gaps and opportunities were considered while developing HirePathAI: 
1. Difficulty in Understanding Job Requirements 
Candidates sometimes find it difficult to understand all the technical skills mentioned in a

job description. HirePathAI aims to make these requirements easier to compare with the 
skills available in a resume. 
2. Lack of Skill Gap Awareness 
A candidate may not know which important skills are missing from their profile. The 
missing skill detection feature helps identify these areas. 
3. Need for Learning Resources 
After identifying missing skills, candidates may need help finding suitable learning 
materials. HirePathAI provides relevant YouTube learning links for this purpose. 
4. Resume Improvement 
Freshers may have difficulty preparing a professional resume. The resume builder facility 
aims to support them in creating or improving their resumes. 
5. Better Job Matching 
Searching through many vacancies can take time. Job recommendations and matching 
scores can help users understand which opportunities are more closely related to their 
skills. 
6. Multiple Career Facilities on One Platform 
Candidates may use different websites for job searching, resume preparation, and learning 
new skills. HirePathAI aims to bring these facilities together in one place. 
These identified areas provided the direction for designing the main features of 
HirePathAI. The project focuses on making the job-search process more informative and 
supporting candidates in improving their skills. 
2.6 Research Findings 
The study of online job portals, resume analysis methods, and AI-based recruitment 
systems helped in understanding the requirements of an effective job-search platform. 
The review indicates that online job portals have made it easier for candidates to explore 
employment opportunities and communicate with employers. At the same time, AI-based 
techniques offer additional possibilities for examining resumes, comparing skills, and 
recommending suitable jobs. 
The major findings from this study are: 
1. Online job portals provide a convenient way to search for employment opportunities. 
2. Resume information plays an important role in understanding a candidate's 
qualifications and abilities. 
3. Comparing resume skills with job requirements can help candidates identify areas that 
need improvement. 
4. Job recommendation systems can make it easier to discover relevant opportunities. 
5. Learning resources can support candidates in developing skills required by employers. 
6. Resume-building facilities can be helpful, especially for students and freshers.

7. AI-based recruitment tools should provide understandable results and be checked for 
accuracy and fairness. 
Based on these findings, HirePathAI was planned as a platform that combines job 
searching with resume analysis and skill improvement facilities. 
The project aims to provide a useful experience by allowing candidates to search for jobs, 
check their skills, identify missing requirements, access learning links, and improve their 
resumes. Thus, the literature review provides the background for the system analysis and 
design explained in the next chapter.

CHAPTER 3: SYSTEM ANALYSIS

A feasibility study is performed to determine whether a project can be developed and used

system. 
The feasibility of the HirePathAI Job Portal is explained below.

Technical feasibility checks whether the required technology, software, and hardware are 
available to develop the project. 
HirePathAI is designed as a web-based job portal. It uses web development technologies to 
provide features such as user registration, job searching, resume uploading, resume analysis, 
and job recommendations. 
The project can be developed and tested using commonly available development tools and a 
computer system with internet access. 
Therefore, the project is technically feasible. 
3.1.2 Operational Feasibility 
Operational feasibility checks whether users can understand and operate the system easily. 
HirePathAI provides a simple process for job seekers: 
1. Users register or log in. 
2. They explore available jobs or companies. 
3. They upload their resumes.

Therefore, the project is economically feasible for academic development. 
3.2 Existing System 
In the traditional job-search system, candidates search for vacancies through different job 
websites, company career pages, newspapers, or personal references. 
Candidates generally create resumes separately and apply for jobs according to the information 
provided by employers. They may need to compare job requirements with their own skills 
manually. 
Most traditional job portals mainly focus on displaying vacancies and accepting applications. 
Candidates may have to use separate platforms to identify skill gaps and find learning resources. 
3.3 Limitations of Existing System 
Some common limitations of traditional job-search systems are: 
1. Manual Job Searching: Candidates may spend a lot of time searching for suitable 
vacancies. 
2. Difficulty in Skill Identification: Users may not easily understand which skills are 
missing from their resumes. 
3. Separate Learning Platforms: Candidates need to search for learning materials on 
other websites. 
4. Resume Improvement: Users may find it difficult to identify weaknesses in their 
resumes. 
5. Job Matching: Finding jobs that match a candidate's qualifications and skills can be 
challenging. 
6. Time Consumption: Searching for jobs and comparing requirements manually can 
take considerable time.

resumes, and receive information about missing skills. 
It also provides YouTube learning links so users can find learning material related to the 
identified skill gaps. Resume-building support and job recommendations are also part of the 
planned project features.

5.7.2 Matching Score 
A matching score represents the similarity between the candidate's available skills and the 
required skills of a selected job. 
A basic skill-based matching score can be calculated using the following formula: 
Matching Score = (Matched Skills / Total Required Skills) × 100

Total required skills = 5 
Matched skills = 4 
Matching Score = (4 / 5) × 100 
Matching Score = 80% 
This means that 4 out of the 5 required skills were identified in the candidate's profile.
